dog.description_text:
🐾💕 MEET LEFTY — LITTLE GUY, BIG PERSONALITY! 💕🐾
Hey there, future family! My name is Lefty, and I may be smaller than my black-coated buddy Pancho, but I've got just as much love and personality to share! ❤️
I'm a sweet, playful little guy who LOVES to explore, run around, and discover new adventures! 🐶🐾
I can be a little shy when we first meet, but give me some time to get comfortable, and you'll see just how lovable I really am!
And yes, I've got a voice! 😂 I can be a little yappy and might even treat you to an occasional howl!
🐱 I also enjoy chasing the cats, but don't worry — I'm just being playful, not aggressive!
🏡 I'm looking for a forever family who will give me patience, plenty of playtime, and all the love a little pup could dream of!
dog.name: Lefty
